title: Fake bank KYC update / account block SMS
transcript_body: Dear customer your SBI YONO account will be blocked today due to pending KYC. Update your PAN immediately using the link below and share the OTP sent to your mobile to keep the account active.
what_happens_next: The link opens a copy of the bank's login page. The OTP you share completes a transfer or adds the scammer's phone as a new device.

title: Caller posing as bank officer asking for OTP
transcript_body: Hello sir I am calling from your bank head office. There is a suspicious transaction on your card. To cancel it please tell me the OTP you just received and your card number and expiry date.
what_happens_next: The OTP authorises a payment or a card-not-present purchase, not a cancellation.

title: Credit card reward points expiring
transcript_body: Your credit card reward points worth Rs 7,850 will expire today. Redeem now at the link and enter your card details and OTP to claim cash into your account.
what_happens_next: The fake redemption page captures card number, CVV and OTP and uses them for online purchases.

title: UPI collect request disguised as a payment to you
transcript_body: I am sending you the advance payment for the item you listed on OLX. Please approve the request on your UPI app and enter your PIN to receive the money.
what_happens_next: Approving a collect request and entering the UPI PIN sends money out of your account. You never need a PIN to receive money.

title: Money 'sent by mistake', please return
transcript_body: Bhaiya maine galti se aapke account mein 5000 rupees bhej diye hain. Please wapas kar do, yeh mere hospital ke paise the. Aapko request bhej raha hoon.
what_happens_next: There is usually no real credit, only a fake SMS. The 'return' goes to the scammer, or the request pulls more money from you.

title: Part-time job liking YouTube videos (task scam)
transcript_body: Earn Rs 3000 daily from home. Just like YouTube videos and rate hotels, Rs 50 per task. Join our Telegram group. To unlock premium tasks with higher commission deposit Rs 1000 first.
what_happens_next: A small first payout builds trust; then 'premium tasks' need ever larger deposits and withdrawals are blocked by fake taxes.

title: Fake offer letter with registration or training fee
transcript_body: Congratulations! You have been selected for the post of data entry executive at Amazon. Your offer letter is attached. Pay the refundable registration and laptop security fee of Rs 2,499 to confirm joining.
what_happens_next: After the fee, more charges follow (verification, uniform, insurance). No real company charges candidates to join.

title: 'Digital arrest' by fake police / CBI on video call
transcript_body: This is Inspector Sharma from Mumbai Cyber Crime. A parcel with drugs was booked on your Aadhaar. You are under digital arrest. Do not disconnect the video call and do not tell anyone. Transfer your savings to the RBI safe account for verification.
what_happens_next: Victims are kept on camera for hours and told to move savings to 'safe accounts' that belong to the gang. Digital arrest does not exist in Indian law.

title: Courier / customs parcel held with illegal items
transcript_body: Your FedEx parcel to Taiwan has been seized by customs. It contains passports and drugs. Press 1 to talk to the customs officer. A case will be registered against you if you do not pay the clearance fine.
what_happens_next: The call is passed to a fake officer who demands a fine or moves to a digital arrest.

title: Mobile number to be disconnected by TRAI / DoT
transcript_body: This call is from TRAI. Your mobile number will be disconnected in 2 hours because it was used for illegal activity. Press 9 to speak to the officer.
what_happens_next: The 'officer' asks for Aadhaar details and money to stop the disconnection or a fake police case.

title: India Post / courier redelivery fee
transcript_body: India Post: your package is held at the warehouse due to an incomplete address. Update your address within 24 hours at the link and pay Rs 25 redelivery charge.
what_happens_next: The small fee page steals card details and OTP, which are then used for larger payments.

title: Look-alike login page for a known brand
transcript_body: Your account has been limited. Verify your account now at http://paypa1-secure-login.verify-account.top/signin to restore access.
what_happens_next: Anything typed on the page (password, OTP, card) goes to the attacker, who then logs into the real account.

title: Fake bank email with failed sender checks
transcript_body: From: HDFC Bank Alerts <alerts@hdfcbank-secure-verify.com>. Your NetBanking access will be suspended within 24 hours due to incomplete KYC. Click the link and enter your customer ID, password and OTP.
what_happens_next: Credentials and OTP entered on the page are used to log in and add a payee.

title: QR code that opens a fake reward or payment page
transcript_body: Scan this QR code to receive your SBI reward points cashback. Enter your account details on the page that opens.
what_happens_next: QR codes are for paying, not receiving. Scanning leads to a payment request or a phishing page.

title: KBC / lottery prize with processing fee
transcript_body: Congratulations! Your number has won Rs 25 lakh in the KBC lucky draw. To claim the prize contact our manager on WhatsApp and pay the GST and processing fee of Rs 12,500.
what_happens_next: Every payment is followed by another fee (tax, RBI clearance, transfer charge). There is no prize.

title: Stock tips WhatsApp group with fake trading app
transcript_body: Join our VIP stock market group. Our analysts give guaranteed 30% monthly returns. Download our institutional trading app and invest through the IPO allotment account shared by the admin.
what_happens_next: The app shows fake profits. Withdrawals need 'taxes' or 'commission', and the group disappears.
source_name: Securities and Exchange Board of India

title: Crypto doubling or mining platform
transcript_body: Invest USDT in our AI crypto mining platform and double your money in 15 days. Withdraw anytime. Limited slots, deposit today to get the bonus.
what_happens_next: Early small withdrawals are allowed to build trust, then the platform freezes all funds.
source_name: Securities and Exchange Board of India

title: Instant loan app with upfront fee or harassment
transcript_body: Pre-approved instant loan of Rs 2 lakh without documents. Pay Rs 1,999 processing fee to release the amount today. Install the app and allow contacts access.
what_happens_next: Either no loan arrives, or the app copies contacts and photos and later blackmails the borrower.

title: Loan app recovery blackmail with morphed photos
transcript_body: Repay immediately or we will send your morphed photos to everyone in your contact list and post them online. You have one hour.
what_happens_next: Paying does not stop the threats; the demands repeat. Report and keep evidence.

title: Electricity bill disconnection tonight
transcript_body: Dear consumer your electricity power will be disconnected tonight at 9.30 pm because your previous month bill was not updated. Please immediately contact our electricity officer on this number.
what_happens_next: The 'officer' asks you to install a screen-sharing app or pay a small amount through a link, then empties the account.

title: Screen-sharing app to 'fix' a refund or KYC
transcript_body: To process your refund please install AnyDesk from the Play Store and share the 9 digit code with me so I can help you complete the form.
what_happens_next: The caller watches your screen, reads OTPs and makes transfers while 'helping'.

title: Fake 'relative in trouble' from a new number
transcript_body: Hi Mum this is my new number, my phone broke. I need to pay a bill urgently, can you send Rs 18,000 to this account? Don't call, I can't talk right now.
what_happens_next: The money goes to a mule account. Calling the relative on their old number exposes the trick.

title: Aadhaar / PAN details for 'verification'
transcript_body: Your Aadhaar is linked to suspicious SIM cards. Send a photo of your Aadhaar and PAN card and the OTP from UIDAI to verify your identity.
what_happens_next: The documents are used to open bank accounts, SIMs or loans in your name.

title: Income tax refund approval link
transcript_body: Income Tax Department: you are eligible for a tax refund of Rs 15,490. Verify your bank account details at the link to receive the refund today.
what_happens_next: The page collects net-banking credentials. Real refunds are credited automatically to the validated account.

title: Auto-debit renewal you did not order
transcript_body: Your Norton antivirus subscription has been renewed for Rs 24,999. If you did not authorise this, call our refund desk immediately.
what_happens_next: The refund desk asks you to install a remote app and 'type the refund amount', which actually sends money.
source_name: US Federal Trade Commission, consumer advice

title: Online friend needing money for customs or travel
transcript_body: My love, I sent you a gift parcel with jewellery and dollars but it is stuck at Delhi customs. Please pay the clearance fee so they can deliver it. Don't tell your family yet.
what_happens_next: A fake customs officer calls and the fees keep increasing. The 'friend' never meets in person.
source_name: US Federal Trade Commission, consumer advice

title: Fake payment screenshot from a buyer
transcript_body: I have paid Rs 9,500, here is the screenshot. It shows pending, please send the product now or refund the extra amount I sent by mistake.
what_happens_next: Screenshots are edited. Check your own bank statement before sending anything.

title: Fake government scheme or free recharge link
transcript_body: PM free recharge yojana: all Indian users get 3 months free recharge of Rs 239. Click the link and share with 10 groups to activate before the offer ends.
what_happens_next: The page collects phone numbers and spreads malware or ads; some ask for payment details.

title: SIM swap or eSIM upgrade request
transcript_body: Your SIM card will be blocked within 24 hours. Upgrade to 5G eSIM by replying with the 20 digit number on your SIM and the OTP you receive.
what_happens_next: The scammer moves your number to their SIM and receives your bank OTPs.

title: Work-from-home data entry with security deposit
transcript_body: Hiring for part time work from home. Typing and data entry, earn Rs 25,000 per month. Pay a refundable security deposit of Rs 1,500 to get the login ID.
what_happens_next: The work is rejected for 'errors' and the deposit is kept, sometimes with a fake legal notice demanding more.

title: Ponzi deposit scheme with high fixed returns
transcript_body: Invest Rs 1 lakh in our chit fund and get Rs 10,000 every month guaranteed. Bring two members and get extra commission.
what_happens_next: Returns are paid from new members' money until the scheme collapses.

title: Social media account will be deleted
transcript_body: Instagram: your account violated copyright rules and will be deleted in 24 hours. Appeal here to keep your account and enter your password to confirm.
what_happens_next: The account is taken over and used to message your friends for money.

title: Fake RTO e-challan link
transcript_body: Your vehicle KA01AB1234 has a pending traffic e-challan of Rs 500. Pay within 24 hours to avoid court action. Download the e-challan app from the link.
what_happens_next: The 'app' is a malicious APK that reads your SMS and OTPs. Real challans are paid only on the Parivahan e-challan portal.

title: FASTag KYC expiry
transcript_body: Your FASTag will be deactivated today due to incomplete KYC. Update KYC at the link to avoid double toll charges.
what_happens_next: The page asks for net-banking or card details and OTP. FASTag KYC is done only through the issuing bank's own app or branch.

title: LPG gas connection KYC or subsidy
transcript_body: Your Indane gas connection will be blocked as e-KYC is pending. Call our KYC executive and install the support app to complete it.
what_happens_next: The support app gives the caller control of your phone; they then read OTPs and move money.

title: Fake army officer buyer on OLX / Marketplace
transcript_body: I am an army officer posted at the base, I want to buy your sofa. Our payments go through the army account, first send Rs 1 to verify and then scan this QR to receive the full amount.
what_happens_next: Each 'test' payment or QR scan sends money from you; the amount grows with every attempt.

title: Fake customer care number from web search
transcript_body: Thank you for calling Flipkart customer care. To process your refund, share the OTP you received and install the screen sharing app so I can help.
what_happens_next: Fake helpline numbers are posted online; callers are asked for OTPs or remote access to 'process the refund'.

title: Sextortion after a video call
transcript_body: We have recorded your video call. Pay Rs 30,000 within one hour or we will send the video to all your contacts and upload it on YouTube.
what_happens_next: Paying leads to more demands. Do not pay; keep evidence and report on cybercrime.gov.in or 1930.

title: PM Kisan or government subsidy via APK
transcript_body: PM Kisan Yojana: your Rs 6,000 instalment is on hold. Download the PM Kisan app from this link and verify your Aadhaar to receive the money.
what_happens_next: The APK steals SMS and banking credentials. Government schemes do not send app download links by SMS or WhatsApp.

title: Fake IPO or institutional trading account
transcript_body: Exclusive IPO allotment for VIP members. Transfer funds to our institutional account to get guaranteed listing gains of 40 percent.
what_happens_next: Money goes to mule accounts; the 'trading app' shows fake balances that can never be withdrawn.
source_name: Securities and Exchange Board of India

title: Overseas job visa and medical fee
transcript_body: Selected for a job in Canada with salary 3 lakh per month. Pay visa processing and medical fee of Rs 45,000 to confirm your seat this week.
what_happens_next: There is no job; more fees follow and the 'agent' disappears. Check recruiters on the eMigrate portal.

title: Fake bank reward or cashback via WhatsApp APK
transcript_body: SBI Rewardz: your 5,000 points expire today. Install the SBI Reward APK sent on WhatsApp to redeem cash into your account.
what_happens_next: The APK forwards your SMS and OTPs to the attacker, who then drains the account.

title: Salary credit alert
transcript_body: Dear Customer, your A/c XX4417 is credited with INR 52,300.00 on 01-10-2026 towards SALARY FOR SEP 2026. Avl Bal: INR 61,882.40.
what_happens_next: This is the usual format of a genuine alert: it reports something that already happened and asks you for nothing. Messages that copy this format but add a link, a mobile number to call, an app to install or a request to return money are scams.
